checks.name: single cte totals
checks.sql: WITH paid_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid') SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS total_spent FROM paid_orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC, customer_id;

checks.name: multi cte join
checks.sql: WITH paid_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'), summarized AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS total_spent FROM paid_orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.name, s.total_spent FROM customers c INNER JOIN summarized s ON c.id = s.customer_id ORDER BY s.total_spent DESC, c.name;

checks.name: recursive cte unsupported
checks.sql: WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM nums WHERE n < 3) SELECT n FROM nums;
checks.expected_error: recursive CTE is not supported yet
